research_question: Can a causal one-sided widening of the native Dukascopy XAUUSD bid-ask spread identify a short-lived quote-price dislocation whose subsequent spread mean reversion is tradeable on the independent Coinexx-like P75 execution surface?

sources.name: Engle & Patton — Impacts of Trades in an Error-Correction Model of Quote Prices
sources.reconstruction: Bid and ask quotes are cointegrated through the spread; the paper reports strong spread mean reversion and asymmetric quote response, with buyer-initiated trades primarily moving ask and seller-initiated trades primarily moving bid.

sources.name: Jegadeesh & Titman — Short-Horizon Return Reversals and the Bid-Ask Spread
sources.reconstruction: Short-horizon negative serial covariance/reversal is consistent with inventory-based microstructure effects; used only as reversal mechanism support, not for fitted coefficients.

sources.name: Larkin & Larkin — When, Not Which Way
sources.reconstruction: Dukascopy FX quote data show timing can be predictable while direction-agnostic breakout monetisation fails and spreads defend high-activity windows; motivates testing a quote-state transition rather than another activity threshold.

source_qa.separation_rule: native spread is signal information only; executable P75 quotes determine entry/exit economics

event_grammar.shock: relative to the immediately previous native BBO snapshot, exactly one quote side moves outward and the other side is unchanged, so native spread widens
event_grammar.sell_shock: ask moves upward while bid is unchanged; mean-reversion direction=SELL
event_grammar.buy_shock: bid moves downward while ask is unchanged; mean-reversion direction=BUY
event_grammar.event_identity: consecutive outward changes on the same side belong to one shock episode until the native spread first narrows or the opposite quote changes

profiles.rule: enter mean-reversion direction at the first executable P75 tick at/after the one-sided outward shock

do not enter at shock; enter only when the moved native quote first moves inward and thereby narrows the spread before the opposite quote has moved; direction remains the original mean-reversion direction
do not enter until native spread has returned to or below the pre-shock spread before the opposite quote has moved in the shock direction; direction remains the original mean-reversion direction

evaluation.economics: frozen DELTA 30-second initial-hold execution: 0.01 lot, P75 BUY ask/SELL bid entry, protective stop 300 raw, trail activate 100 raw, trail distance 30 raw, max hold 30s, $0.01 entry + $0.01 exit commission
diagnostics: median and p90 native shock-spread expansion

anti_overfit: No QIM/OFI overlay in this unit.
If all three structural timing semantics fail executable economics, retire family.
